results.title: Odpowiedzialność za działania w afekcie : problem asymetrii

abstracts.content: An experimental research (conducted by D. Pizarro et al.) has revealed an asymmetry in assigning responsibility for morally bad and morally good actions taken under the influence of emotions. The asymmetry consists in that people tend to assign less responsibility to the agent if his/her morally bad action was made under the influence of emotions, but if his/her action was morally good then the fact that he/she took this action under the influence of emotions is not treated as justifying the diminishing his/her responsibility. This asymmetry is a puzzle that requires explanation. The article discusses the explanation proposed by the authors of the experiment (based on the concept of ‘meta-desires’) and offers an alternative explanation drawing on the distinction between an antecedent emotion (passio antecedens) and consequent emotions (passio consequens) proposed by Thomas Aquinas in his Summa Theologiae.

results.title: Postawy Polaków wobec ocieplenia, transformacji energetycznej i dekarbonizacji

abstracts.content: Zdecydowana większość Polaków wie lub wierzy, że klimat się ociepla. W 2021 roku dwie trzecie Polaków akceptowało potrzebę transformacji energetycznej, a w tym potrzebę stopniowego rezygnowania z węgla i przechodzenia na bardziej ekologiczne źródła energii (74%). Natomiast 19% respondentów było zdania, że energetyka powinna bazować na krajowych złożach węgla kamiennego. Interesujące są wyniki badań na temat dekarbonizacji, które zostały przeprowadzone wśród górników w 2022 roku. Większość respondentów godzi się na warunki umowy społecznej na transformację sektora górniczego. Natomiast jedna trzecia respondentów jest zaskoczona decyzjami władz o dekarbonizacji gospodarki polskiej i  wyraża w tej sprawie umiarkowany lub duży sprzeciw. W lutym 2023 roku CBOS przeprowadził kolejne badania na temat postaw Polaków wobec transformacji energetycznej, z których wynika, że w ostatnim czasie wzrósł udział zwolenników pozyskiwania energii z rodzimego węgla oraz elektrowni jądrowych. Medialny dyskurs publiczny na temat ocieplenia oraz zamierzonej transformacji energetycznej przebiegał w UE i w Polsce pod koniec drugiej dekady XXI w klimacie alarmizmu ekologicznego i klimatycznego. W latach 2020-2023 wiele się wydarzyło na świecie: pandemia, wojna w Ukrainie, kryzys energetyczny. Pod wpływem tych procesów wiele  tez i programów stało się na nowo przedmiotem debat i sporów. Obecnie dyskurs charakteryzuje znacznie większa, niż przed 2020 rokiem, otwartość na rozmaite strategie zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa energetycznego. Novum polega na tym, że pojawia się coraz więcej analiz, programów i wypowiedzi popierających stanowisko, że wszystkie dotychczasowe źródła energii powinny być traktowane z równą uwagą przy jednoczesnym mocnym wspieraniu odnawialnych źródeł energii.

The majority of Poles know or believe that the climate is warming. In 2021, two thirds of Poles accepted the need for energy transformation, including the need to gradually abandon coal and switch to more ecological energy sources (74%). However, 19% of respondents were of the opinion that the energy sector should be based on domestic hard coal deposits. The results of research on decarbonization that were conducted among miners in 2022 are interesting. Most respondents agree to the terms of the social contract for the transformation of the mining sector. However, one third of respondents are surprised by the authorities' decisions to decarbonize the Polish economy and express moderate or strong opposition to this matter. In February 2023, CBOS conducted further research on Poles' attitudes towards the energy transformation, which shows that the share of supporters of obtaining energy from domestic coal and nuclear power plants has recently increased. The public media discourse on warming and the intended energy transformation took place in the EU and Poland at the end of the second decade of the 21st century in a climate of ecological and climate alarmism. In the years 2020-2023, a lot happened in the world: pandemic, war in Ukraine, energy crisis. Under the influence of these processes, many theses and programs became the subject of debates and disputes again. Currently, the discourse is characterized by much greater openness to various strategies for ensuring energy security than before 2020. The novelty is that there are more and more analyses, programs and statements supporting the position that all existing energy sources should be treated with equal attention while strongly supporting renewable energy sources.

book.title: Evolution of new working spaces : changing nature and geographies

results.title: A taxonomy of new working spaces

abstracts.content: In this chapter, we present a definition of new working spaces (NeWSps). We then delve into the unique characteristics of different types of NeWSps. We propose a typology that classifies these spaces based on the primary needs of their users, distinguishing between two approaches: “do it together” and “do it yourself”. Drawing from our literature review, we introduce the concepts of coworking spaces, creative hubs, living labs, corporate labs, makerspaces, fab labs, open worklabs and hackerspaces. We argue that while these types of NeWSps share some similarities, there are important differences between them, and they may overlap in certain dimensions. To capture the wide range of new working spaces, we present two perspectives on makerspaces and creative hubs: lato sensu and stricto sensu.

results.title: Education and democracy nexus : social media as a 'Space' of formation of a sense of responsibility for oneself and for others among young people

abstracts.content: In this chapter, a problem of educating young people in order to make them actively engaged in public life is analysed. Democracy, like hardly any other form of government, requires ongoing consolidation and cherishing of common values, as well as responsibility to protect these values being a condition sine qua non for the democratic community to exist. Educating young people so they feel responsible for themselves, for others, and for the community lies at the very core of any democratic system. Social media seems a vital meeting point for those who educate and those who are being educated. Indeed, social media being a place of social encounters is in itself a new frame for social encounters requiring a special kind of responsibility. However, the ethical imperative of responsibility, i.e. being responsible for others, to care for the common good, calls for acceptance of responsibility as a ‘respondere’, a dialogue with the person who chooses me and reaffirms me in my identity. In this chapter, social media is discussed as a ‘platform’ where the meeting of the teacher and the student, the parent and the child is manifested through shaping in a young person the ‘meaning’ of responsibility for oneself, for others, for the community, for the public sphere, and for democracy in particular.

results.title: The exploitation of religious passions in the U.S. constitutional practice : the Christian Right and the judicial review

abstracts.content: This article seeks to examine the uneasy relations between the modern liberal constitutional state and religious organizations, and the role a constitutional court can play in this regard. Attempts to institutionalize Christian cultural preferences required translating these demands into legal obligations or exemptions and, by extension, into Supreme Court decisions, which are discussed in more detail. In the area of Establishment Clause jurisprudence the Supreme Court of the USA moved to a regime that requires direct funding of religious enterprises, while in the current Free Establishment Clause jurisprudence the Court practically abandoned the Employment Division v. Smith decision which means that the government needs to demonstrate a compelling interest in targeting a religious practice. This stance proved very consequential during the COVID-19 pandemic, when the Court blocked some governmental regulations protecting public health. I argue that this is the Scopes Monkey Trial revisited and a feigned problem-solving.

results.title: Humor jako interpretacja rzeczywistości

abstracts.content:
Oto próba dowiedzenia, że humor może posłużyć za narzędzie zachęty do interpretacji rzeczywistości – co wynika z szeregu omówionych tutaj przyczyn. Humorystyczne memy czy dowcipy są starannie konstruowane tak, by wywoływać pożądany efekt jedną prostą kreską, czy też pociągnięciem pędzla – co wymaga interakcji odbiorcy, który powinien dorysować sobie to, czego w tak naszkicowanej scenie brakuje. Zebrane tu przykłady humoru znalezionego w sieci plasują się w kilku kategoriach, jak nagłe od
krycie podobieństwa między różniącymi się elementami (moment Eureka!), konieczność 
znajomości złożonego kontekstu, odniesienia do stereotypów, skryptów komicznych, symboli narodowych, tabu, czy innych elementów powodujących emocjonalne napięcie, nawiązań do rozpoznawalnych postaci i ich cech charakterystycznych, a także gier językowych, ironii czy nawet sarkazmu. Kategorie te nakładają się na siebie i wielokrotnie dochodzą do głosu, co tylko podkreśla główne założenie – humor to pułapka, w którą dobrowolne wpadamy dla przyjemności, by dać się zawieść tam, gdzie zwykle sami się nie wybieramy.

The article attempts to demonstrate that humour can be seen as a tool to entice the audience to interpret the reality behind it. This happens for a number of reasons discussed in the article. Humorous memes or jokes taken into consideration are carefully constructed, and thus the scenes they evoke are sketched with single or few “brush strokes”. This implies the necessary interaction of the audience in filling in the missing strokes. The collected examples of online humour are divided into several categories including those involving the sudden discovery of similarity between dissimilar elements (the “aha” moment), the need for a complex background information load such as a political context, references to stereotypes, comic scripts, national symbols, references to taboos and other elements which evoke emotional tension, references to recognizable figures and their flagship traits, as well as  language play, including irony or even sarcasm.  These categories naturally overlap and surface in many examples, which only emphasizes the main claim – humour is a trap that we willingly fall into for the sake of immediate pleasure, and let ourselves to be led where we would not normally want to go.

results.title: Stygmatyzacja poprzez wyśmianie osób w wieku starczym i osób samotnych w XIX-wiecznej społeczności chłopskiej

abstracts.content: Artykuł lokuje się na pograniczu refleksji historycznej i etnologicznej. Dotyczy ona stygmatyzacji osób starszych i samotnych (bezżennych oraz niezamężnych) w XIX-wiecznej społeczności chłopskiej. Autor skoncentrował się na wybranych aspektach stygmatyzacji: relacji stary małżonek – młoda żona, obśmiewaniem takiego związku, przywołaniem humorystycznego balu dziadowskiego, poniżaniem osób bezżennych i niezamężnych na co dzień. Wreszcie autor skupił się na obrzędach deprecjonujących samotnych, szczególnie przywołując „kłodę popielcową” i „podkoziołka”. Wnioski do jakich doszedł pozwalają doszukać się osobliwości odpowiadających podziałowi Polski na zabory. Tradycja notarialna (przy przekazywaniu włości) i metaforyczny charakter obrzędów warunkowały starość i samotność w zaborze pruskim. Zabór rosyjski reprezentował wersję kultury, gdzie rozwinęła się również tradycja umów notarialnych, ale obrzędy były związane jeszcze z dokuczliwą, cielesną stygmatyzacją. Najgorzej wyglądała za to sytuacja w Galicji: nie było tradycji notarialnej w przypadku dziedziczenia włości a tylko prawo zwyczajowe, natomiast obrzędy i praktyki życia codziennego cechowała metonimiczność, wiązały się z realną przemocą.

Lie algebras and eigenvalue problems

abstracts.content: It was recently demonstrated that such classical concepts as eigenproblems and Lie algebras are closely related. A family of appropriate eigenproblems generates any finite-dimensional Lie algebra and, conversely, a Lie algebra generates a set of pairs (F, v), where F is a linear mapping and v its eigenvector. This point of view can be used to describe the invariants of Lie algebras. The application of this procedure is shown in detail on the example of five-dimensional nilpotent Lie algebras

book.title: The Routledge Handbook of the History of Translation Studies

results.title: The cultural turn in translation studies

abstracts.content: The Cultural Turn was one of the most important moments in the history of Translation Studies and a turning point for the discipline. It changed the scope and directions of development of translation research, reorganized its aims and methods and changed its significance within the Humanities. The focus of the discipline was shifted from texts to contexts and hence from the linguistic paradigm to much broader areas of Culture Studies, involving analyses of power relations behind the practice of translation, both contemporary and past. The Cultural Turn opened a space for committed and interventionist approaches, especially in the contexts of feminist, gender and postcolonial studies. Translation scholars have both analysed cultural, ideological and political aspects of translation and taken active positions. As a result, Cultural TS provided a methodological framework for research in other areas of the Humanities, which has come to be known as the translatorial turn in Culture Studies. This chapter traces the inspirations for the Cultural Turn; describes the investigations undertaken in the 1990s; discusses the shifts and changes postulated and enacted, as well as their methodological and interdisciplinary interconnections; looks at the interventionist drive in translation research and points to implications of the Cultural Turn in TS for the further development of the area.

results.title: A new pedagogy of museology? : innovative changes in museum education for cultural heritage, social communication and participation : a casy study

abstracts.content: The educational turn in museums, and educational challenges that exhibition curators face nowadays, indicate the need to consider the future of education in cultural institutions, museums included. The specific pedagogy of the “new museology” is suggestive of the demand for social communication and participation in creating the message museums send and for addressing currently important issues. Therefore, a closer look at the programmes and transformations taking place in museology is required, also because of the need to look into the future and understand the new tasks ahead triggered by the pandemic. The educational partnership in formal and non-formal education is, in a way, entering a new dimension, not only in real life, but also in cyberspace. Is this a “new pedagogy of museology”? The author asks the question, pointing to various deliberations on actual museum practice. In this paper, she reflects on the changes in museology that have resulted in the growth of social participation and the development of the attendant cultural competences in local communities. The methodology of this work is based on the analysis of found materials, such as selected Polish museums’ websites, but also empirical research based on interviews with museum educators, leaders of change in museology in Poland, and finally the author’s own experience of teaching students of museum education. The research concludes by showing the need to develop social and individual competences which require innovative solutions for the general education of every person and the community as a whole. As a result of data analysis, a picture of what can be referred to as a “new pedagogy of museology” is presented, as oriented towards social interaction and communication, choosing values such as the protection of cultural heritage and the peaceful coexistence of generations.

results.title: Bridging cultural boundaries : the challenge of intercultural education

abstracts.content: Procesy globalizacji nie mogą być już rozumiane jako zjawiska unifikacji lub standaryzacji działań podejmowanych w różnych dziedzinach lub regionach współczesnego świata. Konsekwencje globalizacji przyczyniają się do przemieszczania różnych zasobów, ludzi i treści kulturowych, zwiększając interakcje między mniejszymi i większymi społecznościami, strukturami i instytucjami. Intensywne procesy interakcji, które są bezpośrednim wynikiem różnorodności kulturowej, wpływają na politykę edukacyjną, etniczną i społeczną środowisk wielokulturowych. Artykuł podkreśla różnice koncepcyjne, aksjologiczne i metodologiczne związane z edukacją międzykulturową oraz wyzwania, przed którymi stoi w środowiskach wielokulturowych.

The processes of globalization can no longer be understood as phenomena of unification or standardization of activities undertaken in various fields or regions of the modern world. The consequence of globalization contributes to the movement of various resources, people, and cultural content, increasing interaction among smaller and larger communities, structures, and institutions. Intensive interaction processes, which are a direct result of cultural diversity, affect the educational, ethnic, and social policy of multicultural environments. The article highlights the conceptual, axiological, and methodological differences associated with intercultural education and the challenges it faces in multicultural settings

book.title: Museums, narratives, and critical histories : narrating the past for the present and future

results.title: Narrative and resilience : museum exhibitions under forced change : a case study of the museum of the second world war in Gdańsk

abstracts.content:
Article presents analysis of the Museum of the Second World War exhibition. In general, the original version of the exhibition may be interpreted as less "mnemonically secure" for domestic memory users, and the changes are meant to secure their self-image and self-memory. However, my findings suggest that the implementation of the changes may not be
seen as fully effective. On the one hand, an exhibition of a narrative and experiential type may be considered fragile. Such exhibitions are integral, which means
that every change, even the slightest, matters, and additions and eliminations may modify their complex structure. On the other, it proves flexible and responsive: interventions have not been able to smoothly modify the experiential parameters of such exhibitions, i.e., their basic narrative mechanisms (even though they may gradually disrupt the work of these mechanisms). This potential power of an exhibition constitutes its resilience. Exhibition resilience manifests itself in three intertwined ways.

book.title: Progress in Polish Artificial Intelligence Research 5. Proceedings of the 5th Polish Conference on Artifcial Intelligence (PP-RAI’2024) 18–20.04.2024, Warsaw, Poland

results.title: Institutional black boxes pose an even greater risk than algorithmic ones in a legal context

abstracts.content: Black boxes in machine learning (ML) systems can be understood in at least two ways; in relation to (1) an algorithm, i.e., a decision rule, when that rule is impossible for a human to interpret, or (2) the secrecy of that rule (proprietary nature of it), due to business or economic factors. I call the first understanding "algorithmic black boxes" and the second "institutional black boxes". These two understandings are independent of each other, in particular, transparent algorithms can be part of systems that are institutional black boxes. I indicate that when it comes to the application of ML in public institutions applying the law (e.g., courts), institutional black boxes pose a particular threat to the integrity and reliability of ML systems used in such a context. I argue that in the eXplainable Artificial Intelligence trend, more attention should be paid not only to the favourable features of the algorithm (e.g., direct interpretability) but also to the business context in which the ML system is developed. Its secrecy can sabotage the transparency of even the simplest models.

book.title: Research handbook on legal evolution

results.title: Evolution of Roman law

abstracts.content: Roman and civil law is not only a matter of its more than 1,000 years of history in ancient Rome; it also includes the 1,500 years of later European legal tradition, so that up to four lives of Roman law can be demonstrated so far. The development of Roman private law during the first 1,000 years, as well as throughout the rest of legal history, is difficult to assess and so cannot be described simply in terms of progress. Undoubtedly, it is subject to certain changes and developments, and these might sometimes be considered evolution, although, firstly, these always involve human beings and so the same human nature, and, secondly, all legal regulations are validated by their utility and social acceptability, which, as regards relations in the field of private law, is found to be similar in different epochs. It can be noted that the law fluctuates but nevertheless always remains within the spectrum of a certain amplitude of changes—its range of possibilities. Within this range, the law shows a characteristic resilience, resulting from the fact that Roman law is characterized by a staunch acceptance of reality, providing a remarkable ability to improvise at the same time as it passes down—from Roman antiquity to subsequent epochs, and thus to our own times—eternal notions and values that allow us to believe that the lawful life is meaningful.

abstracts.content: Celem pracy jest teoretycznoprawna charakterystyka prokonstytucyjnej wykładni prawa. Dla jego osiągnięcia, prokonstytucyjna wykładnia prawa zostaje najpierw porównana z wykładnią ustaw w zgodzie z konstytucją  (Verfassungskonforme Gesetzesauslegung). Okazuje się, że te dwie techniki interpretacyjne są różne w wielu aspektach, bez względu na to, czy ujmujemy je w sensie pragmatycznym, czy apragmatycznym. Następnie istota prokonstytucyjnej wykładni prawa zostaje objaśniona za pomocą odniesienia jej do pojęcia interpretacji ważeniowej. Analizy prowadzą do wniosku, że prokonstytucyjna wykładnia prawa i wykładnia prawa w zgodzie z konstytucją powinny być pojęciowo odróżniane od siebie, niezależnie od tego, że w praktyce orzeczniczej te dwie techniki wykładni prawa mogą być równocześnie stosowane, głównie w postępowaniach przed sądami konstytucyjnymi, zaś ich rezultaty w postaci decyzji interpretacyjnych mogą być identyczne.

The aim of the paper is the jurisprudential characterisation of the pro-constitutional interpretation of the law. In order to achieve it, the pro-constitutional interpretation is first compared with the interpretation of the law in accordance with the constitution (Verfassungskonforme Gesetzesauslegung). It turns out that these two techniques of interpretation differ in many respects, regardless of whether we conceive of them in a pragmatic or apragmatic sense. Next, the essence of the pro-constitutional interpretation of the law is explained by referring to the concept of legal interpretation based on weighing. The analyses lead to the conclusion that pro-constitutional interpretation and interpretation in accordance with the constitution should be conceptually distinguished from each other, regardless of the fact that in judicial practice these two techniques of legal interpretation may be applied simultaneously, especially in proceedings before constitutional courts, and their results in the form of interpretative decisions may be identical.

results.title: The advantages and disadvantages of teaching the Arabic language to native speakers of Slavic languages

abstracts.content: The present paper examines graphical, phonological, morphological and syntactical similarities and differences between the Arabic language and the Slavic languages as the languages of the learners of Arabic as a foreign language. Although Arabic and Slavic languages belong to different linguistic families (Afro-asiatic versus Indo-European) they share some morphological and syntactical constructions which facilitate the acquaintance of Arabic as a foreign language by the Slavs. The discussed matters are as follows: the different graphical expression of the sounds in the languages (with one historical exception, so called Arebitsa); rich inflection of both Arabic and  Slavic languages (with two exceptions: Bulgarian and Macedonian in nominal forms), including cases and conjugation based on endings for persons, numbers and genders; some special nominal forms like numerals (in many Slavic languages more difficult than the literary Arabic forms); the question of tenses (Arabic Perfect and Imperfect expressing past, present and future in comparison to perfective - imperfective verbs expressing at least three similar tenses in Slavic language, although in many cases presenting more complex view of the time in the latter). The paper also dares to answer the question why sometimes Arabic is seen as a rather regular language by the Slavic languages native speakers.

Technical, logistic and financial limitations of the Polish film and television production in Peoples' Republic of Poland were forcing the creators to creativity where the showing of historical realities was concerned, building fantasy universes, or simply representing foreign countries. The results would have been grotesquely unattractive or surprisingly inventive. The imaginary worlds created in such conditions would have particular qualia and unclear modality status. They would join realism, teatralisation, and the games with the viewer's imagination. In The Stake Bigger than Life, the issue of qualia and formal/material modality is being solved in a creative and attractive manner.

abstracts.content: W moim artykule przedstawiam historię informatyzacji polskiej kolei w okresie PRL ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem programu komputerowego CETAR. Służył on do obliczania należności za przewożone przez PKP towary oraz umożliwiał tzw. bezakceptowe pobieranie należności  bezpośrednio z kont przedsiębiorstw-klientów kolei. System opracowany w pierwszej połowie lat 70. przez zespół kierowany przez dr. Adama Wielądka, został wdrożony w całej sieci PKP w drugiej połowie tej dekady. Wyrok Trybunału Konstytucyjnego z kwietnia 1989 r. położył kres automatycznemu pobieraniu należności od klientów, a sam system został ostatecznie wyłączony dopiero w 2007 r. Wskazując na różnorodne formy kontaktu pracowników PKP z systemem CETAR interpretuję go jako przejaw specyficznie rozumianej "wyspowej" nowoczesności na kolei w PRL - dopasowany do warunków politycznych tego czasu oraz mechanizmów gospodarki nakazowo-rozdzielczej.

In my article, I present the history of the computerisation of the Polish railways in the People's Republic of Poland, with particular emphasis on the CETAR computer program. It was used to calculate the charges for goods transported by the Polish State Railways and enabled the so-called non-acceptance (automatic) collection of charges directly from the accounts of railway customers. The system, developed in the first half of the 1970s by a team led by Dr. Adam Wielądek, was implemented throughout the whole rail network in the second half of that decade. Although at the end of communism in Poland the Constitutional Tribunal's ruling in April 1989 put an end to the automatic collection of charges from customers, the system itself was finally shut down only in 2007. By pointing out various forms of contact between Polish State Railway employees and the CETAR system, I present its functioning as an examples of a specifically understood modernity on the railways in Poland - adapted to the political conditions and the mechanisms of a command-and-distribution economy.

abstracts.content: In this article I present two works connected with two cultures, Semitic and Hellenic and I research poetic features each of them. These are the Eucharistic prayer from the "Didache" treatise (1st century) and the "Paschal Homily" of Melito of Sardis (2nd century), which stand out from the background of early Christian literature for their poetry, which is rare for this era. The chapters 9‒10 from Didache are a poetic prayer, strongly rooted in Semitic poetics, inspired by both the genres and content of the Old Testament books; in many places, the "Paschal Homily" has a poetic and rhythmic structure, and the main message of this homily is reading of the Old Testament as models. The synthesis of Greek and Semitic culture takes place on the linguistic level; in the case of the "Didache", the analogy to pagan prayer poetry may be accidental, although the hymnic features of the Eucharistic song are the same as in non-Christian works. In turn, the structure of the "Paschal Homily" is based on the Aristotelian principle of the division of speech, but the interwoven poetic passages make it a rhetorically ambiguous work

abstracts.content: The issue known as concors secum, concord with oneself, is undoubtedly less frequently addressed by the authors of various literary epochs. It appears to be  much more attractive to depict an inner split, a conflict, a clash of oppsing ambitions, desires and passions. Yet, equally creative (and artistically attractive) may be to present the pursuit of reconciliation with oneself. The very problem has both psychological and ethical aspects. Some of the aspects of this  issue have  been discussed using the selected examples: Euripdes' Phaedra, Walter Scott's The Lady of the Lake, Alessandro Manzoni's The Betrothed, Leo Tolstoy's Anna Karenina, Joseph von Echendorff's Ahnung und Gegenwart and Thoma Mann's The Magic Mountain.

results.title: Narrative competence of bilingual Ukrainian children compared to their Polish peers : a comparative approach

abstracts.content: In this article we compare the level of narrative competence of 6 and 7 year old Ukrainian and/or Russian speaking preschool children at the threshold of school readiness with the abilities of their Polish peers. The chances children in that age group have of achieving success at school on par with their cognitive capacity improve if they acquire the ability to understand and craft cohesive and linguistically correct narratives whilst employing a variety of skills to do so. This also helps them function in a peer group. 30 Ukrainian and/or Russian speaking children and the same number of Polish speaking children took part in the research, carried out according to the BID procedure. An analysis of the obtained material made it possible to assess and compare the level of narrative competence development for both groups. Consequently, areas where Ukrainian and/or Russian speaking children should be subject to linguistic stimulation in order to provide them with a better start at the next educational stage were identified.

abstracts.content:
Rozdział poświęcony debacie parlamentarnej zawiera krótką historię polskiego parlamentaryzmu, a także  miejsca i roli debat w pracach polskiego sejmu. Autorka skupia się szczególnie na aspekcie rytualnym i organizacyjnym debat, gdyż znaczna formalizacja zachowań językowych to cecha konstytutywna tego typu zdarzeń komunikacyjnych, zależnych od regulaminu i porządku obrad. W szczególności określone zostały zasady debatowania i przypisane uczestnikom określone role warunkujące ich zachowania komunikacyjne, a także specyfika języka parlamentarnego, jak np. formuły słowne i ściśle określone gatunki debaty parlamentarnej, limitowany czas wystąpień, a także ich kolejność zapisywania się do głosu, warunkowana porządkiem obrad. Ponadto debata parlamentarna opisana została w aspekcie społecznym i kulturowym na tle przeobrażeń języka polityki oraz dyskursu publicznego, które są dla niego istotnym tłem, podobnie jak poszczególne kadencje parlamentarne, stanowiące względnie jednorodne czynniki kształtujące przebieg poszczególnych debat, jak: skład poselski, określony stosunek sił politycznych itp. Poświęcono także nieco uwagi specyfice perswazji w debacie parlamentarnej. Podział na koalicję i opozycję i określona przynależność polityczna posłów sprawiają, iż zazwyczaj przed debatą jej uczestnicy wiedzą, jak będą głosować, szczególnie istotna staje się więc rola odbiorcy masowego debat parlamentarnych i ich teatralizacja w celach 
pozytywnej autoprezentacji i degradacji przeciwników politycznych

The chapter devoted to the parliamentary debate contains a short history of Polish parliamentarism, as well as the place and role of debates in the work of the Polish Parliament. The author focuses particularly on the ritual and organizational aspects of debates, as significant formalization of linguistic behaviour is a constitutive feature of this type of communication events, depending on the rules and agenda. In particular, the rules of debating were defined, and the participants were assigned specific roles conditioning their communication behaviour, as well as the specificity of the parliamentary language, such as verbal formulas and strictly defined genres of parliamentary debate, limited time of speeches, as well as their order of subscribing to the floor, conditioned by the agenda. In addition, the parliamentary debate is described in the social and cultural aspect against the back-ground of transformations in the language of politics and public discourse, which are an important back-ground for it, as well as individual parliamentary terms, which are relatively homogeneous factors shaping the course of individual debates, such as: political, etc. Some attention has been also devoted to the specificity of persuasion in the parliamentary debate. The division into the coalition and the opposition and the specific political affiliation of deputies mean that usually before the debate its participants know how they will vote, so the role of the mass audience of parliamentary debates and their theatricalization for positive self-presentation and degradation of political opponents becomes particularly important.

results.title: Komunikowanie treści o charakterze naukowym z wykorzystaniem Twittera w niszy #AcademicTwitter

abstracts.content: Badacze mediów są świadomi, że powinni być zaangażowani w komunikowanie nauki również poza uczelnią. Strategie komunikacyjne mogą obejmować śledzenie pracy i dyskusji innych osób, zarówno akademickich, jak i tych spoza środowiska akademickiego, a także autopromocję lub reklamę konkretnego programu. W ciągu ostatnich kilku lat można zaobserwować rosnącą popularność tweetowania, zwłaszcza wśród nauczycieli akademickich, ponieważ stało się ono jedną z najczęściej stosowanych metod rejestrowania codziennego życia w środowisku akademickim. W niniejszym artykule wybrano osiem kont na Twitterze prowadzonych przez nauczycieli akademickich, którzy są nano-influencerami, i podjęto próbę odpowiedzi na pytanie, w jaki sposób ci nauczyciele codziennie wywierają wpływ na niszę akademicką, wykorzystując koncepcję kręgu wpływu Stephena Coveya oraz koncepcję neoliberalizmu. Wyniki badań sugerują, że codzienne tweety, opisujące wyniki w nauce, są żywą manifestacją tego, jak użytkownicy Twittera konstruują swoje tożsamości jako przedstawiciele współczesnego społeczeństwa akademickiego, przedstawiając siebie jako zorganizowane i zmotywowane jednostki, które pokazują codzienne życie akademickie, wraz z jego wzlotami i upadkami, w środowisku akademickim.

Media researchers are aware that they should also be involved in popular scholarly communication outside the academy. Communication strategies can range from following the work and discussions of others, both academic and non-academic, to self-promotion or advertising a particular programme. Over the past few years, we have seen the growing popularity of tweeting, especially among academics, as it has become one of the most widely used methods of recording everyday life in academia. This paper selects eight Twitter accounts run by academics who are nano-influencers and attempts to answer the question of how these academics exert influence in the academic niche on a daily basis, using Stephen Covey's concept of circle of influence and the concept of neoliberalism. The findings suggest that these daily tweets describing academic performance are a vivid manifestation of how Twitter users construct their identities as representatives of contemporary academic society, portraying themselves as organised and motivated entities that show the everyday life of an academic, with its ups and downs in academia.

results.title: Koncept "pasji myślenia" Karola Irzykowskiego

abstracts.content: Pasja twórczego myślenia to postawa intelektualnej aktywności w nieustannym ruchu, występująca przeciw finalizacji w ciągłym dostosowywaniu się warunków poznania do rzeczywistości, rozumianej przez Irzykowskiego w dynamicznym aspekcie. Wypełnia postulat rzetelności poznawczej w wariancie refleksji nad sposobami myślenia, prowadząc ku afirmacji "życia myślenia" i "myślenia życia". To nie tylko myślowa strategia Irzykowskiego czy postulowana koncepcja literatury, ale projekt antropologiczny w syntezie życia i sztuki. Modernistyczna pasja myślenia jako postawa twórcza wzmacnia indywidualność i wolność w samoświadomym kreowaniu sensu oryginalnej tożsamości, wychodząc naprzeciw modernizacji.

Karol Irzykowski constructs the aesthetics of passion in critical literary works as a life and creative attitude. Passion vis-à-vis modernisation is a distinctive formula of experience as an enduring life attitude of the creator, not relying solely on the construction of an image. The experience of passion unites passion and thought, unifying thought and life. The passion of thought is identical with creation.  The necessary complement to the above creative attitude is the volitional action and the effort undertaken. The hardship inherent in the creative process marks the duality of understanding passion as suffering and love.
